lines.text: That little punk, he didn't even care about the statue.
That statue was a cultural treasure of this island.
All the food and supplies we gathered have also been destroyed, Mr. Teisel.
We have nothing left to sell in the store.
It's up to Tron and Bonne. We have to get the Mother Lode.
If we don't, I don't know what will happen to us.
We won't even be able to pay rent. We'll be homeless.
We've lost! Let's get out of here!
Hey, Mega Man! Don't think we're finished!
You haven't seen the last of Teisel Bonne!
